skill.description: 当用户需要做好看视频选题、短视频内容方向规划或竞品角度复盘时使用。基于用户提供的主题或视频链接，整理相关作品、标题角度与评论反馈，输出带样本依据的选题清单。来自 SocialDataX 社媒数据助手。
skill.summary: Plan Haokan video topics using SocialDataX search results, video details, and audience comments.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: One command block runs an unpinned npm package with automatic installation, creating supply-chain exposure in an environment containing an API key. The remaining 39 alerts match Markdown formatting, service links, credential configuration guidance, video identifiers, or readable Chinese text. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or concealed payloads in the reviewed files; the external package implementation was not included.

remediation.issue: SKILL.md:32-59 executes socialdatax-skills@latest through npx -y without a reviewed version pin.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify package provenance and integrity, and obtain approval before installation. Limit runtime credentials to this service.

content.user_title: Plan Haokan Video Topics From Audience Evidence
content.value_statement: Choosing Haokan video topics requires separating audience signals from assumptions. This skill guides SocialDataX searches and comment reviews to produce topic ideas with supporting sources.
actual_capabilities: Guides retrieval of Haokan hot-search terms as topic leads, not video rankings.
Searches related videos by keyword through the SocialDataX CLI or corresponding MCP tools.
Retrieves video details by video ID or URL.
Reviews video comments and retrieves replies using both video and parent-comment identifiers.
Defines sample limits and continuation rules for paginated or partially completed requests.
Structures topic recommendations with audiences, angles, reference titles, priorities, and source links or IDs.
limitations: Requires SocialDataX access and a configured API key; CLI use also requires Node.js, npm, network access, and execution permission.
Depends on external tools not bundled with this skill; API balance limits can interrupt retrieval.
Does not support transcript extraction, --since-days filtering, or --include-replies for Haokan.
Hot-search terms and limited samples cannot establish platform-wide rankings, growth rates, or guaranteed video performance.

use_cases.title: Choose the next video topic
use_cases.description: Review related videos and audience questions to select a focused topic with a clear audience and source evidence.

use_cases.title: Compare competitor content angles
use_cases.description: Inspect selected competitor videos and comments to distinguish recurring title angles from unmet audience needs.

use_cases.title: Prepare an evidence-based editorial shortlist
use_cases.description: Combine topic leads, video facts, and comment feedback into prioritized suggestions while documenting sample limits.

prompt_templates.title: Explore one topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Haokan video ideas about [topic] for [audience]. Start with one search page and cite the sources behind each suggestion.

prompt_templates.title: Review a reference video
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [Haokan video URL] and its available comments. Suggest three follow-up topics, separating video facts, audience feedback, and your recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Compare competing angles
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these Haokan videos: [URLs or IDs]. Summarize title angles and audience questions, then prioritize differentiated topics with source evidence and sample limits.

prompt_templates.title: Build a bounded research shortlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] for [audience]. Limit search to [pages] pages and [items] items. Review three relevant videos and selected comment threads. Report priorities, source IDs, collection time, and gaps. Preserve partial results and resume only with valid continuation tokens.

output_examples.input: Illustrative supplied sample A: a balcony gardening video titled 'Choosing containers'; comments ask about drainage. Suggest a follow-up for beginners.
output: Candidate topic: Drainage basics for balcony containers.
Angle: Answer the drainage questions in supplied sample A.
Reference title: How to Choose a Container With Good Drainage.
Priority: Review first because the supplied comments identify a specific question.
Evidence: Supplied sample A only; no live retrieval or broader trend claim.

output_examples.input: Illustrative retrieval result: one page was retained, the next request failed, and no continuation token was returned. Report the status.
output: Retained evidence: The first page remains available for limited analysis.
Missing evidence: Additional pages were not retrieved.
Recovery: Resolve the error and inspect continuation information before another request.
Boundary: Do not restart automatically or present the sample as complete.

best_practices: Define the topic and audience, start with one page, and review one to three relevant videos before expanding.
Keep source facts, comment feedback, and recommendations separate; include source identifiers, sample size, observation time, and missing information.
Use a reviewed, pinned CLI package and keep credentials private; preserve partial results and continue only within approved retrieval limits.
anti_patterns: Treating hot-search terms as video rankings or proof of platform-wide growth.
Inventing transcripts, performance metrics, audience quotes, or source evidence that retrieval did not return.
Repeating failed or insufficient-balance requests without checking recovery rules, remaining limits, and continuation tokens.

faq.question: What input can I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a topic, target audience, Haokan video URL, or video ID. A focused question helps narrow the sample.

faq.question: What setup does this skill require?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY for SocialDataX access. Direct CLI execution requires Node.js, npm, network access, and permission to run commands.

faq.question: Can it publish or interact with my account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow retrieves data only. It does not log in, publish, like, comment, or modify accounts.

faq.question: Can it extract video transcripts?
faq.answer: No. Haokan transcript extraction is unsupported. Analysis uses returned titles, descriptions, and comments.

faq.question: Do hot-search terms prove video popularity?
faq.answer: No. They provide topic leads, not video rankings, playback totals, or growth measurements.

faq.question: What happens when a request fails?
faq.answer: Preserve partial results and report missing data. Check the error before retrying; insufficient balance requires account resolution rather than repeated requests.
